current_date: Hub page last updated 23 February 2026 (PF04 Full planning page last updated 26 August 2026; no adoption date stated)
current_evidence: Peterborough publishes its local list as live web pages: the 'Apply for planning/building permission' hub says 'This is our local list of validation requirements' and links one checklist page per application type, including the PF04 page Grokbot used (last updated 26 August 2026).

issues.detail: The Validation list URL and Planning page both point to the single Full Planning (PF04) checklist page. They do not point to the hub that holds the local list, which is split across about 19 application-type pages (PF01 householder, PF11 LBC, PF12 adverts, PF23 reserved matters, etc.).
issues.evidence: Hub page: 'This is our local list of validation requirements' with links to PF01, PF04, PF05, PF06, PF10, PF11, PF12, PF14, PF15, PF23, PF25, PF27, PF31, PF34, PF39 etc.

issues.detail: List date and Date basis are blank and the list is flagged 'Undated'. The pages do carry dates: the hub was last updated 23 Feb 2026, PF04 on 26 Aug 2026 and PF01 on 20 Mar 2026. Many individual sections say 'Updated: February 2017'. There is no formal adoption date.
issues.evidence: PF04 page: 'Last updated: 26 August 2026'; sections: 'Updated: February 2017'

issues.detail: Householder shows '(none)', but the PF01 householder checklist sets several local requirements. CIL Questions form for new residential development of 100 sq m and over, including householder extensions. Tree or Arboricultural Survey for all minor proposals, including householder, where trees are on or next to the site (Level 2 BS5837 survey for TPO trees, conservation areas or major development). Biodiversity checklist for all household and minor development that creates new floorspace. Noise Impact Assessment where there is potential noise nuisance. FRA in Flood Zone 2/3 where the footprint increases.
issues.evidence: PF01: 'Tree or Arboricultural Survey - Local requirement - Required for all Minor Proposals (including householder) where trees are on or adjacent to the proposed site'; CIL: '(this includes householder extensions)'

issues.detail: Three local requirements on the PF04 Full planning page were not captured. Open Space: residential schemes of 10 or more dwellings or 0.5 ha or more. Retail or Leisure Impact Assessment: new retail and/or leisure floorspace over 2,500 sq m. Lifetime Homes details: proposals of 15 or more dwellings.
issues.evidence: PF04: 'Open Space ... developments of 10 dwellings or more or residential developments of 0.5 hectares or more'; 'Retail or leisure development Impact Assessment ... greater than 2,500 square metres'; 'Lifetime Homes details ... 15 or more dwellings'

issues.detail: Listed building consent captures only Structural Survey. The PF11 LBC page also says 'Always required' for a Protected Species Survey and for Detailed Drawings, and requires a Design and Access Statement for any LBC application, subject to exceptions. Other application types (advertisement PF12, LDC PF14/PF15, s73 PF25, discharge PF27, NMA PF34, trees PF31, s106 PF39) are marked '(none)' even though each has its own checklist page, which Grokbot did not read apart from s73.
issues.evidence: PF11 (last updated 08 June 2026): 'Detailed Drawings - Always required'; 'Protected Species Survey - Always required'; 'Design and Access Statement - Required for any application for listed building consent, except where'

issues.detail: The CIL Additional Information trigger is cut off at 'For applications creating;' and drops the actual threshold.
issues.evidence: PF04/PF01: 'CIL Questions form - New residential development of 100 square metres and over'

issues.detail: Several requirements taken from the Mineral Working checklist page are placed under Full planning as if they applied generally. 'Protected Species Survey Always required' is mapped to Ecological Survey. 'Phasing masterplan showing each phase of excavation and restoration' is mapped to Design Code/Masterplan. The hydrological assessment 'for all applications involving extraction' is mapped to Ground investigation. Landscaping Details also comes from the minerals page. These triggers apply only to mineral working applications.
issues.evidence: Source URL for these rows: .../carrying-out-of-mineral-working-and-associated-development; trigger 'A report is required for all applications involving extraction'

issues.detail: Grokbot labels application types arbitrarily. Biodiversity Checklist is placed under 'Change of use - prior approval', although its trigger names household and minor development and it comes from the outline page. Land Contamination is placed under 'Minerals & waste (county)', although its source is the general PF04 list. Fire Statement is placed only under Reserved matters, although the trigger says 'full and reserved matters'. About 20 Full planning rows carry the 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' note even though the PF04 page is the Full planning checklist.
issues.evidence: Fire statement: 'Required for full and reserved matters applications where the proposal contains two or more dwellings...'

issues.detail: Several tab items are page boilerplate or link fragments rather than requirements. Examples: 'Policy PP3 ... FR Standing Advice 228KB– pdf Size: 228KB ... Share page to Twitter ... Print'; 'Peterborough Developer Contributions Supplementary Planning Document - July 2019 (PDF, 408KB)...'; 'Application form to carry out mineral working ... 937KB– pdf'; the biodiversity explanation 'We require the checklist to be completed because we have a duty to consider...'. The Fire Statement trigger also ends in 'Download guidance Download application form ... Back to top Share page to Twitter'.
issues.evidence: Tab items in sections 'Submission rules' and 'Local forms / checklists'

issues.detail: Environmental Statement (EIA) appears as a Full planning requirement, but the PF04 page says it is not part of the local list. Several triggers also begin with the garbled prefix 'Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015' or 'Policy PP3 ...' carried over from the previous section's policy reference.
issues.evidence: PF04: 'Environmental Impact Assessment ... This not part of the local list'

issues.detail: The drawing standards tab repeats the same block plan, floor plan and elevation text from several pages (PF01, PF04 change of use, PF06, minerals), producing near-identical items.

summary: Grokbot's link works and is a live, current part of Peterborough's web-based local list, but it covers only the Full planning page. Householder is wrongly shown as having no local requirements. Open Space, Retail/Leisure Impact and Lifetime Homes are missing, and many rows are mis-assigned or include page boilerplate.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
